correctness.rationale: Walsh orthogonality and antipodal complementarity give C=I/2 plus an even/odd block. Direct conditioning establishes the only needed Fourier coefficients alpha=a_d and beta=-a_d/(d-2). The pair-incidence identity R*R=(d-2)I+11* yields exactly one symmetric singular value a_d sqrt((3d-1)/2) and d-1 standard singular values a_d(d-1)/sqrt(d-2), all positive. Rank d and dimension subtraction prove every eigenvalue multiplicity including the dimension-three zero/one degeneracy. Explicit normalized singular vectors give sharp extremizers. Algebraic inequalities prove strict levels for odd d>=5 and Stirling proves limits. A dependency-free exact-integer checker from the actual package verifies 16,215 Gram entries and 2,049 coefficient identities at d=3,5,7,9,11,13, plus 4,999 exact ratio identities; computations supplement the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines the complete exact Slepian spectrum on a canonical half-density majority region for all odd dimensions at the first bandwidth beyond linear Walsh functions. Gives both distinct symmetry channels and multiplicities, sharp concentration extremizers, a quantitative condition number and its nonzero all-dimensional limit, not a routine half-energy parity identity. The family is natural in multiscale Boolean harmonic concentration and stable spatial sampling. The zero-dimensional boundary at d=3 is stated explicitly, and no unproved higher-band, even-dimensional or noisy-recovery consequences are asserted.
